evidence.detail: Speed up signup by loading fewer decks — switched from loading all decks ever to a LIMIT 10 query; reduced from 2s to 81ms
Merged PR that introduced recent_decks_for_person and fixed league.py signup form
DecklistForm now calls deck.recent_decks_for_person(person_id) which uses LIMIT 10 with current season filter — not all decks ever

triage.notes: The original slow code path was in league.py (LeagueForm); it was refactored into DecklistForm in form.py with the efficient recent_decks_for_person function.
triage.proposed_comment: Fixed in commit 5d143779 (PR #11297): replaced the load-all-decks-then-slice-10 pattern with a targeted SQL query using LIMIT 10, reducing signup load time from ~2s to ~81ms.
